strings: While it's only a minor irritation at best, m_c still goes to talk to r_c0 about the dull ache in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head.
With m_c's bad eye and all the squinting {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'ve/'s} done it's no wonder {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head is starting to complain.
m_c knows the day isn't starting well when there's a dull thumping in {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} head.
